title: CHIC 1BR Hideout – Sleeps 6 Perfect for Fun Nights
description:
Nashville Getaway – 1BR Apartment Near Downtown Nashville (Sleeps 6)

Just 8 minutes from the heart of downtown Nashville, this stylish one-bedroom apartment is the perfect home base for your Music City adventure. Spend the day exploring Broadway’s honky-tonks, historic sites, and local dining — then retreat to your modern, comfy getaway stocked with everything you need to relax.

The space
The modern and comfy getaway will leave you in awe with its carefully picked amenity list. 

★ LIVING ROOM ★ – Sleeps 2
Relax with family or friends while streaming your favorite shows or enjoying a game night.
✔ Cozy sofas with plush pillows
✔ Flat-screen TV
✔ Coffee table
✔ Sleeper sofa (sleeps 2)

★ KITCHEN ★ – Fully Equipped
Whether you’re whipping up breakfast before hitting the town or cooking a late-night snack, this kitchen has all the essentials.
✔ Microwave
✔ Stove
✔ Oven 
✔ Refrigerator/freezer
✔ Dishwasher
✔ Toaster
✔ Blender
✔ Full cookware
✔ Silverware, glasses, and trays
✔ Sink with hot & cold water

★ BEDROOM ★ – Sleeps 4
Recharge in the spacious and comfortable bedroom designed for a restful night’s sleep.
✔ 2 Queen-size beds with fresh linens & pillows
✔ Wardrobe with hangers & shelves

★ BATHROOM ★ – Fresh & Functional
Everything you need for a refreshing start (or end) to your day.
✔ Full shower
✔ Toilet & mirrors
✔ Towels 
✔ Essential toiletries

Guest access
★ AMENITIES ★
✔ High-speed Wi-Fi
✔ Air conditioning & heating
✔ Ceiling fans
✔ Washer & dryer (in-unit)

★ Guest Access
The entire apartment is yours to enjoy with full privacy during your stay. So relax, unwind, and make yourself at home.
